messages.text:
*Hello,

I am writing about my order Shop···· (Harlo B30, formerly BSB B30).

According to your last update, my unit is in Batches 2 and 3, with shipping planned for the first week of November. I have not received a tracking email so far.

Could you please tell me:
1. Has my B30 already shipped? If yes, please send me the tracking number.
2. If not, what is the current expected ship date for my order?
3. Has the Power K. already shipped, and is there a separate tracking number for it?

Please also confirm that the price I paid at checkout is still locked.

Thank you very much and best regards
Jürgen E.*

*=====*

Am 15.09.2026 um 22:54 schrieb Helium Deploy:

Hi Jürgen,

Thank you for writing. Your B30 has not shipped yet, so there is no tracking number for it. I'm sorry. We told you on September 15 that it would ship in the first week of November, and we missed that date.

Here is where it stands. Your order is set to ship from our warehouse in the Netherlands. The B30 units for Europe from batches 2 and 3 are on their way there now. The batch 2 shipment was held up in transit. Both batches are due at the warehouse in late November. Your B30 ships once its unit is checked in, and the tracking number comes to you by email as soon as it leaves. You can follow the batch on its way to us here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

Your Power K. (EU plug) is already at the Netherlands warehouse and set aside for you. It hasn't shipped yet. It will go out in the same parcel as your B30, so you'll get one tracking number for both.

Your price is locked. You paid $839 at checkout and the order is paid in full. You owe nothing more, and the Power K. stays free. Because it ships from inside the EU, you won't pay any import VAT or duties on delivery.

Best regards,
Sarah
